modes.definition_zh: 把'我希望知道确信知识的真条件是什么'当作一次完整的工程检测：安萨里在《迷途指津》中系统检验每一层知识来源——感官知识被梦与错觉推翻（梦中之物醒后皆虚，谁能担保醒时不是另一重梦？），理性知识被'是否有比理性更高的裁判'推翻。凡是可怀疑的一律整体悬置，但怀疑本身不是目的——它是对根基的应力测试，目的是找到那'近在而不可怀疑'的明晰性。要害有三：其一，来源级审计而非逐条修补——不做打补丁式的怀疑，而是把赖以决策的全部来源（感官、理性、权威、直觉）列成清单逐一拆验；其二，怀疑与确信一线之隔——'我像一心求财的商人心悬一线'，悬置期是焦灼的投资而非舒适的姿态；其三，重建优先——悬置之后必须找到不可怀疑的残余基点，并以此逐层重建。方法论签名：怀疑不是终点站，是对知识地基的载荷试验；通过试验的才配继续承载。
modes.definition_en: Treat the question 'what are the true conditions of certain knowledge?' as a complete engineering stress test: in al-Munqidh min al-Dalal, al-Ghazali audits every layer of his knowledge sources—sense data fall to dream and illusion (dreamt objects prove false on waking; who guarantees waking is not another dream?), and reason itself falls to the question of a higher judge. Whatever can be doubted is suspended wholesale—yet doubt is not the goal; it is a load test of foundations, seeking the 'proximate, undoubtable' clarity. Three essentials: source-level audit rather than patch-by-patch doubt—inventory every source you rely on (sense, reason, authority, intuition) and dismantle each; doubt and certainty hang by a thread—'I was like a merchant perilously poised,' the suspension is anxious investment, not a comfortable pose; and rebuilding comes first—after suspension you must locate the indubitable remainder and rebuild layer by layer. Signature: doubt is not the terminus but the load test of the foundation of knowledge; only what survives the test may carry weight.
modes.source_chapter: 《迷途指津》（al-Munqidh min al-Ḍalāl）§2-4、《圣学复苏》卷一'知识篇'
process_zh: 列出当前赖以决策的全部知识来源（感官、理性、权威、直觉），登记为被检对象
对每一来源构造最强反例（错觉之于感官，循环论证之于理性），逐一拆验
将可疑来源整体悬置，不急于替换，忍受'怀疑蔓延'的焦灼期
寻找不可怀疑的残余基点，并以此逐层重建可信知识，重建结果须能回溯到该基点
process_en: Inventory every knowledge source you rely on (sense, reason, authority, intuition) and register each as an auditee
Construct the strongest counterexample for each (illusion vs. sense, circularity vs. reason) and dismantle them one by one
Suspend the suspect sources wholesale; do not rush a replacement—endure the anxiety of spreading doubt
Locate the indubitable remainder and rebuild trusted knowledge layer by layer, with every rebuilt belief traceable to that base
modes.key_quote_zh: 怀疑不再局限于某一命题，而是蔓延到一切知识——直到我最终确信：唯有近在的明晰性不容怀疑。
modes.key_quote_en: Doubt spread from a single proposition to all knowledge—until I became certain that only the proximate, self-evident truths are immune to doubt.
representative_cases_zh: 1095年巴格达危机：安萨里作为帝国最高学府尼扎米亚学院首席教授，公开承认自己对讲台上讲授的每一命题都已失去确定性基础，遂以'健康原因'辞去教职（实为认识论危机），闭门十年。这不是学术失足，而是把怀疑当作一次完整的工程检测：感官层、理性层、教义学层、哲学层逐一拆验，最后在苏菲体验层找到不可怀疑的基点，才带着重建的知识重返写作。
《迷途指津》梦证实验：他把'梦中得来的巨额财富醒来分文无有'作为感官不可靠的判例——由一个可重复的日常经验直接推翻整层知识来源，而非依赖玄思。
先于笛卡尔五百年：从怀疑感官到怀疑理性再到'不可怀疑的明晰性'的完整怀疑—重建程序，被比较哲学界与《第一哲学沉思集》并置研究——同一程序在两个文明中独立出现，说明它是认识论危机的通用解法。
反例警示：悬置而无重建是学术自毁——安萨里明确记录悬置期'语言行为尚存而心中已无信念'的空洞状态；只拆不建，怀疑就从中立工具变质为慢性毒药。
representative_cases_en: The 1095 Baghdad crisis: as chief professor of the Nizamiyya, the empire's highest academy, al-Ghazali publicly conceded he had lost the foundations of everything he taught, resigned citing 'health' (in fact an epistemic crisis), and spent ten years auditing sense, reason, theology, and philosophy until Sufi experience yielded an indubitable base—then returned to writing with rebuilt knowledge.

The dream experiment in al-Munqidh: he uses 'immense wealth gained in a dream that vanishes on waking' as the standing verdict on sense data—one repeatable everyday experience overturns an entire layer of knowledge, no metaphysics required.

Five centuries before Descartes: the full doubt-then-rebuild sequence from doubting sense to doubting reason to the indubitable proximate clarity is studied side by side with the Meditations—the same procedure arising independently in two civilizations marks it as the generic cure for epistemic crisis.

Counter-case: suspension without rebuilding is self-destruction—al-Ghazali records the hollow state of 'speech and conduct persisting while belief had left the heart'; dismantling without rebuilding turns doubt from a neutral instrument into a slow poison.
modern_applications_zh: 科研范式危机应对：当反常数据堆积时，做一次'来源级'审计而非逐条打补丁（库恩式范式检验）
个人重大转向决策（转行/转信仰/转战略）：系统性怀疑优于情绪化否定，且必须预设重建方案
AI 安全与对齐：把'模型的哪些信念来源可信'作为独立审查层，悬置不可验证的来源
尽职调查与审计准则：先列证据来源清单，再逐层构造反例测试其可靠性
modern_applications_en: Paradigm crises in research: run a source-level audit when anomalies pile up, not patch by patch (Kuhn-style testing)
Major life pivots (career, faith, strategy): systematic doubt beats emotional negation—and always pre-plan the rebuild
AI safety and alignment: audit which of the system's belief sources are trustworthy as a separate layer; suspend the unverifiable
Due diligence standards: inventory evidence sources first, then stress-test each layer's reliability with counterexamples

modes.definition_zh: 承认知识有一个论证永远够不到的最高形态：'真主抛入心中之光'——一种直接、不可言传、却比任何演示推理更牢固的确信。理性论证的价值在于排除错误、清理道路，但'目的地'只能由体验抵达，如同'知道蜂蜜的定义'与'亲口尝到甜'之别、'知道健康的定义'与'真的健康'之别。要害有三：其一，给直觉确信独立的认识论席位——不废黜理性，而是把'亲证'（dhawq，字面即'尝'）登记为与概念知识并列的合法进路；其二，主体条件先行——当论证链完备而内心仍无确信时，问题可能不在论证，而在主体尚未具备接受这种知识的净化条件；其三，防止冲动冒充确信——真确信带来行动与持守，假确信（一时情绪）随境而逝。方法论签名：论证负责'不可能错'的排除工作，'该不该走'的最终裁决留给体验与确信。
modes.definition_en: Grant that knowledge has a highest form argument can never reach: 'the light God casts into the heart'—direct, ineffable, firmer than any demonstration. Reason's job is to exclude error and clear the road, but only experience reaches the destination, as knowing the definition of honey differs from tasting sweetness, or defining health differs from being healthy. Three essentials: an independent epistemic seat for conviction—without dethroning reason, register dhawq (literally 'tasting'), direct experience, as a legitimate route alongside conceptual knowledge; subject-conditions first—when the argument chain is complete yet the heart holds no certainty, the defect may lie not in the argument but in the subject lacking the purification needed to receive it; and guard against impulse impersonating certainty—true conviction issues in action and endurance, false certainty (mood) fades with circumstance. Signature: argument does the exclusion work—'cannot be wrong'; the final verdict on 'should we go' belongs to experience and conviction.
modes.source_chapter: 《迷途指津》§5-7、《圣学复苏》卷一'心之science'
process_zh: 用理性论证完成排除工作：确定哪些道路已被证明不通，压缩选项空间
识别该领域所需的主体条件（净化、实践、脱网），逐一满足后再进入体验
在具备条件后进入体验，捕捉'不证自明'的确信时刻，如实记录
以行动与后续验证确证该确信：真确信导向持续行为，情绪冲动则随境消散
process_en: Let argument finish the exclusion work: establish which roads are proven dead and compress the option space
Identify the subject-conditions the domain requires (purification, practice, disengagement); meet them before entering experience
Once conditioned, enter the experience and capture the self-evident moment of conviction; record it faithfully
Confirm the conviction through action and follow-up: true conviction sustains behavior; emotional impulse evaporates
modes.key_quote_zh: 知识的最高源头不在笔墨与言辞之间，而在心灵之光中——健康不能靠定义获致，只能靠亲尝。
modes.key_quote_en: The highest source of knowledge lies not in ink and speech but in the light of the heart: health is not attained by definition but by tasting.
representative_cases_zh: 《迷途指津》蜂蜜与健康之喻：教义学家能精确定义'健康的性质、成因与分类'，却没有一人真正健康——概念知识与实践性知识的差别不可通约。安萨里据此把苏菲之道（亲证）制度化地承认为与教义学（概念）并列的合法知识进路，在不废黜理性的前提下为体验知识正名。
确信三阶的实操编码：他把确信分为'知识之确信'（知道毒是毒）、'状态之确信'（见到毒发而确信）、'品味之确信'（亲尝后的牢固的确信）——为'知道-见过-尝过'三级经验设立了可教的语言。
十年修验的裁决作用：1095年后他未靠任何新论证皈依苏菲，而是以修验获得确信后再写作《圣学复苏》——'确信先行于文本'，而非文本先行于确信。
反例警示：他同时警告'伪体验'——未经净化条件的人宣称的'确信'多为自我暗示；无主体条件的体验主张不具裁决资格。
representative_cases_en: The honey and health metaphors (al-Munqidh): theologians can define health's nature, causes, and taxonomy precisely, yet none is thereby healthy—conceptual and practical knowledge are incommensurable. On this ground al-Ghazali institutionally admitted the Sufi path (direct tasting) as a legitimate epistemic route alongside theology, without dethroning reason.

Operational coding of three grades of certainty: knowledge-certainty (knowing poison is poison), state-certainty (seeing its effect), and taste-certainty (the firm assurance after tasting)—a teachable vocabulary for knowing / having-seen / having-tasted.
The decade of practice as adjudicator: after 1095 he embraced Sufism on no new argument but on attained conviction, writing the Revival afterward—conviction precedes text, not text conviction.

Counter-case: he warns against 'pseudo-experience'—'certainty' claimed without the purification conditions is mostly autosuggestion; experience asserted without subject-conditions carries no verdict weight.
modern_applications_zh: 专家判断与数据分析的关系：数据负责排除错误选项，'手感'裁决最终取舍——决策流程中显式设置两个环节
技能习得设计：知道规则≠获得能力，培训体系必须含必经的实践-体验环节（飞行时数、临床轮转）
重大战略决策：论证完成风险排除后，留出'确信检验'环节再下注
用户体验与产品判断：指标证明'不差'，只有试用体验能裁决'该不该做'
modern_applications_en: Expert judgment vs. data: data excludes wrong options; seasoned intuition adjudicates the final call—make both stages explicit in decision processes
Skill-acquisition design: knowing rules ≠ having ability; training systems must include the mandatory practice-experience loop (flight hours, clinical rotations)
Major strategic decisions: after argument rules out risk, run a conviction check before committing
Product and UX judgment: metrics prove 'not bad'; only hands-on experience can verdict 'should we build it'

modes.definition_zh: 追问'必然联结'本身：我们观察到的只是火与燃烧的恒常伴随，从未观察到'必然'本身。安萨里在《哲学家的矛盾》第十七题给出惊世骇俗的解构：火不烧棉——真主在每一瞬间依其常道（sunna，本义'习俗'）在棉中创造燃烧；火只是燃烧发生的'场合'（occasion）而非原因。把'恒常伴随'误认为'必然联系'，是理性对自身习惯的僭越。要害有三：其一，把因果断言还原为观察陈述——先问'我们究竟观察到了什么'，把理论承诺从观察中剥离；其二，区分信心层级——逻辑必然、已证规律、恒常伴随三者置信度完全不同，不可混用；其三，为'常道中断'预留本体论空间——异常不是统计尾巴，而是结构上可能的事件。此模式是休谟问题在十一世纪的先声。方法论签名：'从未失败过'与'不可能失败'之间隔着一条理性不能僭越的鸿沟。
modes.definition_en: Interrogate necessity itself: we observe only the constant conjunction of fire and burning, never necessity. Al-Ghazali's seventeenth discussion of the Incoherence delivers a stunning deconstruction: fire does not burn the cotton—God creates the burning in the cotton at each instant according to His custom (sunna, literally 'habit'); fire is the occasion of burning, not its cause. Mistaking habituated conjunction for necessary connection is reason's usurpation by its own habit. Three essentials: reduce causal claims to observation statements—ask first 'what exactly did we observe?' and strip theoretical commitments from observation; grade confidence levels—logical necessity, proven law, and constant conjunction carry wholly different warrant and must not be mixed; and reserve ontological room for 'interruption of custom'—anomalies are not statistical tails but structurally possible events. This is Hume's problem, six centuries early. Signature: between 'never failed' and 'cannot fail' lies a gap reason may not cross.
modes.source_chapter: 《哲学家的矛盾》第十七题、《中道神学》论因果章
key_concepts: 恒常伴随 vs 必然联结
process_zh: 把因果断言还原为观察陈述：逐字追问'我们究竟观察到了什么？'
识别'必然性'断言中未被观察填充的部分（联想、习惯、理论承诺）
区分三层并分别赋予信心等级：逻辑必然 / 已证规律 / 恒常伴随
为'常道中断'（异常、黑天鹅）预留本体论空间，据此前瞻性地设计冗余与对冲
process_en: Reduce causal assertions to observation statements: ask word by word 'what exactly did we observe?'
Identify the unobserved residue inside 'necessity' claims (association, habit, theoretical commitment)
Distinguish three tiers and grade confidence separately: logical necessity / proven law / constant conjunction
Reserve ontological room for interruption of custom (anomalies, black swans); design redundancy and hedges prospectively on that basis
modes.key_quote_zh: 火并不燃烧——燃烧者在每一瞬间由永恒者创造；所谓必然，不过是造物之常道在我们的想象中凝固成的锁链。
modes.key_quote_en: Fire does not burn—the burning is created at each instant by the Eternal; what we call necessity is His custom frozen into chains by our imagination.
representative_cases_zh: 《哲学家的矛盾》第十七题火-棉分析：安萨里承认火总是伴随燃烧（否则医生无法工作、日常行动失去依据），但坚持这一伴随是'真主的习俗'而非火的本质力量——正是因此，奇迹（如易卜拉欣入火不焚）在结构上可能而非逻辑矛盾。他保住了宗教的可能性空间，同时没有否认任何一条经验规律。
伊本·鲁世德的《矛盾的矛盾》逐题反驳：八十年后重立因果必然论与哲学合法性——这场论战恰好定义了'因果必然性是否可从观察中导出'这一至今未决的哲学问题，双方都成为后世哲学史的必经坐标。
与休谟的结构同构：休谟'我们只能观察到恒常联结，从未观察到必然联系'的论证与安萨里的解构在六百年后几乎逐字重合——区别只在休谟诉诸心理习惯，安萨里诉诸神圣常道。
反例警示：偶因论若推到底会摧毁科学的可解释性——安萨里本人以'常道'概念保住了规律的可预期性（'否则医生无法工作'）；解构因果者必须同时回答'行动为何仍可依理进行'。
representative_cases_en: The fire-cotton analysis (Incoherence, 17th discussion): al-Ghazali concedes fire always accompanies burning (else physicians could not work and daily action loses its basis), but insists the conjunction is God's custom, not the fire's intrinsic power—which is precisely why miracles (Abraham unharmed in the fire) are structurally possible, not contradictions. He preserves religious possibility while denying no empirical law.

Averroes's Tahafut al-Tahafut: eighty years later he rebutted point by point, restoring causal necessity and philosophy's license—a debate that thereby defined the still-unresolved question of whether causal necessity can be derived from observation; both became unavoidable coordinates in later philosophy.

Structural isomorphism with Hume: Hume's 'we observe only constant conjunction, never necessary connection' nearly verbatim repeats al-Ghazali's deconstruction six centuries later—the difference being psychological habit versus divine custom.

Counter-case: occasionalism pushed to the end destroys science's intelligibility—al-Ghazali himself preserved the predictability of law via the 'custom' concept ('else physicians could not work'); whoever deconstructs causation must also answer why action can still proceed by rule.
modern_applications_zh: 风险管理与尾部事件：把'从未发生'与'不可能发生'严格分开，资本与安全冗余按后者不可得来设计
机器学习外推警告：训练分布内的恒常伴随不保证分布外的因果有效（OOD 泛化问题）
政策评估：识别相关-因果滑坡，把'习俗性联结'当作可被中断的假设
供应链与基础设施韧性：为'常道中断'（极端事件）预留结构性冗余而非仅做统计尾部处理
modern_applications_en: Risk and tail events: strictly separate 'never happened' from 'cannot happen'; size capital and safety redundancy assuming the latter is unavailable
ML extrapolation warning: constant conjunction within the training distribution guarantees nothing out-of-distribution (the OOD generalization problem)
Policy evaluation: flag correlation-to-causation slides; treat regularities as interruptible assumptions
Supply-chain and infrastructure resilience: hold structural redundancy for interruption-of-custom events, not merely statistical tail treatment

modes.definition_zh: 批判之前，先以对方最强的形式完整转述其学说——这是安萨里为'判教'（裁决异己体系）建立的程序伦理：先有《哲学家的宗旨》中立、系统、甚至优于哲学家自我表述地转述法拉比与伊本·西那的体系，然后才有《哲学家的矛盾》逐题裁决。不经最强形式转述的批判是稻草人批判，不具裁决资格。要害有三：其一，转述与批判分离为独立文本/独立章节，显式声明中立性，使读者可单独检验转述是否公允；其二，以对方自己的术语与框架重建其学说，达到'对方认可这就是我的意思'的标准；其三，列出双方承认的共同前提，把分歧压缩到最小集合再逐题处理。同时它还有认识论红利：转述阶段本身就是最深的学习——安萨里承认转述哲学时'几乎被其精妙折服'，这种诚实使随后的批判更可信。方法论签名：未曾以最强形式转述对手者，无资格宣判对手。
modes.definition_en: Before critique, restate the opponent's doctrine in its strongest form—the procedural ethics al-Ghazali built for adjudicating rival systems: first the Intentions of the Philosophers restates al-Farabi and Ibn Sina neutrally, systematically, even better than they stated themselves; only then does the Incoherence adjudicate point by point. Critique without strongest-form restatement is strawmanning and carries no verdict weight. Three essentials: separate restatement from critique into independent texts or chapters with explicit neutrality declarations, so readers can check fairness on its own; rebuild the doctrine in the opponent's own terms and framework, to the standard 'the opponent would accept this as what I mean'; and list the premises both sides accept, compressing disagreement to a minimal set before itemized treatment. The method also yields an epistemic dividend: restatement is itself the deepest learning—al-Ghazali confesses he was 'almost swept away by its elegance'; such honesty makes the ensuing critique more credible. Signature: whoever has not restated the opponent in its strongest form has no standing to pass verdict on it.
modes.source_chapter: 《哲学家的宗旨》（Maqāṣid al-Falāsifa）全书序、《哲学家的矛盾》各题开头
key_concepts: 两书结构（转述书+裁决书）
process_zh: 以对方自己的术语与框架完整重建其学说，达到'对方认可这就是我的意思'的标准
显式声明转述的中立性，与批判分离为独立文本或独立章节
列出双方承认的共同前提，把分歧压缩到最小命题集合
在最小分歧集上逐题裁决，每题显式标注裁决等级与依据
process_en: Rebuild the opponent's doctrine in their own terms and framework, to the standard 'they would accept this as what I mean'
Declare the restatement's neutrality explicitly; separate it from critique as an independent text or chapter
List premises both sides accept; compress disagreement into a minimal set of propositions
Adjudicate item by item over the minimal set, marking each verdict's grade and grounds explicitly
modes.key_quote_zh: 先如其所是地呈现，再如其所值地裁决——未曾以最强形式转述对手者，无资格宣判对手。
modes.key_quote_en: Present as it is, then judge as it deserves: whoever has not restated the opponent in its strongest form has no standing to pass verdict on it.
representative_cases_zh: 《哲学家的宗旨》的历史讽刺恰是此模式效力的证明：该书被译成拉丁文后，西方读者长期把它当作哲学辩护书而非批判的前奏——转述达到的中立高度使批判书自身成了经院哲学的教科书，间接为阿奎那一代准备了哲学问题域。
转述中的自我诚实：安萨里自述在精确转述哲学家学说时'几乎被其精妙折服'，并以'真主保佑我没有因此迷失'收尾——他不仅未隐藏转述的说服力，反而把它记录在案，使《矛盾》的裁决程序免于'先歪曲再攻击'的指控。
两书结构的程序意义：任何读者可以只读《宗旨》而获得对希腊化哲学的公正理解，也可以对照两书检验每一裁决是否有稻草人嫌疑——批判被置于可审计的轨道上。
反例警示：经院后期与网络论辩中大量存在的'术语走私'（用己方定义复述对方立场再攻击）正是此模式的反面——安萨里以'对方认可'标准直接封死了这条路。
representative_cases_en: The historical irony of the Intentions proves the method: translated into Latin, it was long read in the West as a defense of philosophy rather than a prelude to its refutation—the restatement was that neutral, and the 'refutation prelude' itself became a scholastic textbook, preparing the ground for Aquinas's generation.

Honesty inside restatement: al-Ghazali confesses that while precisely restating the philosophers he was 'almost swept away by its elegance,' closing with 'God preserved me from being lost'—far from hiding the restatement's persuasive power, he put it on record, immunizing the Incoherence against charges of distort-then-attack.

The procedural meaning of the two-book structure: any reader may read the Intentions alone for a fair account of Hellenized philosophy, or read both side by side to audit each verdict for strawman risk—critique placed on an auditable rail.

Counter-case: the 'term-smuggling' rampant in later scholasticism and online debate—restating the opponent's position in one's own definitions and then attacking it—is precisely this method's negative image; al-Ghazali's 'the opponent would accept' standard closes that road outright.
modern_applications_zh: 代码评审与架构争论：先以最强形式复述对方方案并获对方确认，再提异议
竞争分析：先准确转述竞品逻辑，再评估其弱点，避免战略误判
内容审核与学术评审制度：把'中立转述'设为裁决的前置程序门槛
调解与谈判：以'双方认可的分歧清单'替代各说各话，压缩争点
modern_applications_en: Code and architecture review: restate the proposal in its strongest form, confirmed by its author, before objecting
Competitive analysis: model rivals accurately before judging their weaknesses to avoid strategic misreads
Moderation and peer-review systems: make neutral restatement a procedural gate before any verdict
Mediation and negotiation: replace talking past each other with a mutually endorsed list of disagreements

modes.definition_zh: 面对一个庞大异己体系，拒绝整体性标签（'哲学=异端'），而把分歧拆解为有限数量的具体命题（二十题），对每一题独立裁决并显式分级：无争议（对方正确）、可辩护的异端（bid'a，受谴责但不出教）、必须出教（takfir，如否认身体复活）。结果：二十题中仅三题触及出教线，其余为可论辩的技术分歧。要害有三：其一，分歧枚举化——先列出全部具体分歧点，禁止未枚举先定罪；其二，裁决分级显式化——每个命题标注裁决等级与依据（理性、经文、共识），不同等级触发不同对待；其三，整体标签拒斥——不得以最重罪名的三题连带否定二十题全貌。这一程序把'与谁能否合作/对话'从立场问题转化为可核查的命题清单，是分歧管理的工程化。方法论签名：先枚举、再定性、后分级——一揽子敌我判定是思想的懒惰。
modes.definition_en: Face a vast rival system and refuse the wholesale label ('philosophy = heresy'): decompose the disagreement into a finite list of specific propositions (twenty), adjudicate each independently with explicit grades—undisputed (the philosophers are right), defensible innovation (bid'a, censured but not excommunicating), or mandatory excommunication (takfir, e.g., denying bodily resurrection). Only three of twenty cross the excommunication line. Three essentials: enumerate disagreements—list every concrete point of dispute; conviction before enumeration is banned; grade verdicts explicitly—each proposition is tagged with its grade and grounds (reason, scripture, consensus), and different grades trigger different treatment; reject wholesale labels—three gravest charges must not condemn the other seventeen. This turns 'whom can we work with' from a stance question into a checkable proposition list—disagreement management engineered. Signature: enumerate first, characterize second, grade third—a blanket friend-enemy verdict is laziness of thought.
modes.source_chapter: 《哲学家的矛盾》二十题总目与第三、十七、二十题结论
key_concepts: 裁决分级（无争/异端/出教）
process_zh: 把与异己体系的分歧枚举为有限、具体、可单独裁决的命题清单
为每个命题寻找双方共同接受的裁决标准（理性、经文、共识）
逐题独立裁决并显式分级（无争/可辩之异端/必须切割），禁止以最重罪名连带整全体系
基于分级结果重建关系：哪些可以合作、哪些必须分离、哪些继续论辩
process_en: Enumerate disagreements with the rival system into a finite, specific, individually adjudicable proposition list
For each proposition find decision standards both sides accept (reason, scripture, consensus)
Adjudicate each independently with explicit grades (sound / defensible innovation / must-sever); forbid condemning the whole for the heaviest charge
Rebuild relations from the grades: cooperate here, separate there, keep debating the rest
modes.key_quote_zh: 二十题中，惟三题须以出教论处；其余诸题，或哲学家无误，或属可辩之歧——不得以三题之罪，尽废其学。
modes.key_quote_en: Of twenty questions, only three warrant excommunication; the rest are disputable or sound—one must not damn the whole for three.
representative_cases_zh: 《哲学家的矛盾》的实际裁决结构：安萨里承认哲学家在逻辑学、数学、天文学上'无可指摘'（他甚至在《宗旨》中全盘吸收其逻辑进入自己的课程体系），在'否定属性神学'与'世界永恒'上判为可辩之异端，仅在'真主不识殊相''否认身体复活'等三题判出教。'部分吸收、部分谴责、小部分切割'的校准处理，使他既完成对理性主义的清算，又保住逻辑学与数学进入伊斯兰主流教育的通道。
关系重建的后果：二十题裁决使'与哲学家什么可以学、什么必须防'成为教界的可操作指南——此后数百年的伊斯兰学院课程沿此线切分：逻辑数学入课程，形而上三题入禁区。
三题清单的精确性：他把出教线划在'世界永恒之外'的三个具体命题上，并在《精要》中逐题给出推理链——每一裁决都可被独立核查与反驳（伊本·鲁世德正是这样做的）。
反例警示：后世的整体化误读（'安萨里判哲学为异端'）恰恰证明整体标签的顽固——二十题的精细结构被压缩成一句话口号，程序成果在传播中退化为它所反对的东西。
representative_cases_en: The actual verdict structure of the Incoherence: al-Ghazali concedes the philosophers are 'unreproachable' in logic, mathematics, and astronomy (absorbing their logic wholesale into his own curriculum in the Intentions), judges negation-of-attributes and eternity-of-the-world blameworthy innovations, and reserves excommunication for three doctrines such as God's not knowing particulars. 'Absorb in part, censure in part, amputate a little'—calibrated treatment that both settled accounts with rationalism and kept logic and mathematics on the pathway into mainstream Islamic education.

Consequences for relation-rebuilding: the twenty-verdict structure became an operational guide for scholars—what may be learned from the philosophers and what must be guarded against—and for centuries Islamic curricula were cut along this line: logic and mathematics in, the three metaphysical doctrines fenced off.

The precision of the three-item list: he drew the excommunication line at three specific propositions, giving a reasoning chain for each in the Mustasfa—every verdict independently checkable and refutable (as Averroes in fact did).

Counter-case: later wholesale misreadings ('al-Ghazali declared philosophy heresy') prove the stubbornness of blanket labels—the twenty-item fine structure was compressed into a one-line slogan, and the program's outcome degraded in transmission into the very thing it opposed.
modern_applications_zh: 组织内重大分歧处理：把'要不要采纳X路线'拆为命题清单逐项裁决并分级
国际合作与联盟管理：以具体分歧清单替代意识形态整体站队
技术依赖决策：评估外部依赖时逐项分级（可用/有条件/必须替换）
合规与供应商尽调：把'这家公司可信吗'改为'哪几项达标、哪几项违规'的分级审计
modern_applications_en: Major organizational disputes: decompose 'adopt X or not' into a graded proposition list, adjudicating item by item
International cooperation and alliance management: replace ideological blocs with itemized disagreement lists
Technology dependency decisions: grade each external dependency usable / conditional / must-replace
Compliance and vendor due diligence: turn 'is this firm trustworthy?' into a graded audit—which items pass, which violate

modes.definition_zh: 对当时全部知识门类逐一'体检'——《迷途指津》把认识论危机转化为一次分域尽职调查：教义学（本质是护教，不能生产确信）、哲学（在数学逻辑上可靠，在形而上下降格）、伊斯玛仪派（以权威代论证，机制不可接受）、苏菲（唯有它交付了所许诺的确信）。每一门类按统一框架检验：它宣称交付什么？其实际交付机制是什么？失效点在哪里？与目标的匹配度如何？要害有三：其一，统一体检框架——对在位者与挑战者使用同一张检查表，杜绝双重标准；其二，适用域划界——知识不是笼统的'好或坏'，而是'在哪个域内有效'，结论总是'X 在域 D 内有效、在域 E 失效'；其三，目标为尺——以自身最高目标（确信）为标尺，而非以学科传统或社会声望为标尺。这实质是认识论层面的尽职调查与技术选型。方法论签名：先问'它承诺交付什么'，再看'它的机制能不能兑现'，最后写清'它在哪儿失效'。
modes.definition_en: Put every discipline of the age through a uniform battery—al-Munqidh turns epistemic crisis into a domain-by-domain due diligence: theology (essentially apologetics, cannot produce certainty), philosophy (reliable in mathematics and logic, demoted in metaphysics), Isma'ilism (authority substituting for argument—mechanism unacceptable), Sufism (the only one that delivered the promised certainty). Each discipline is examined by the same battery: What does it promise to deliver? By what mechanism? Where does it fail? How well does it match the goal? Three essentials: one uniform checklist for incumbents and challengers alike—no double standards; validity-domain demarcation—knowledge is not generically 'good or bad' but 'valid within which domain'; every verdict reads 'X works in domain D, fails in domain E'; and the goal as yardstick—measure against one's highest aim (certainty), not disciplinary tradition or social prestige. This is due diligence and tech selection at the epistemic level. Signature: first ask what it promises, then whether its mechanism can deliver, finally write down where it fails.
modes.source_chapter: 《迷途指津》全文结构（对四种知识进路的逐一体检）
process_zh: 清点当前可用的全部知识/方法门类，不遗漏任何在位者
对每门类统一体检：宣称目标、交付机制、验证方式、已知失效点
以自身最高目标为标尺给每门类打分并划定适用域（D 内有效 / E 内失效）
输出组合方案：主路、辅路、禁入区，并注明各自的域边界与降级条件
process_en: Inventory every available knowledge/method discipline; omit no incumbent
Run the uniform battery on each: claimed goal, delivery mechanism, verification mode, known failure points
Score each discipline against your highest goal and demarcate its validity domain (works in D / fails in E)
Output a portfolio: main road, support road, no-go zones—with domain borders and downgrade conditions noted
modes.key_quote_zh: 我逐一检验诸学：教义学护教而不能授信，哲学明于数学而昧于形上，唯有苏菲之道交付了它所许诺的确信。
modes.key_quote_en: I examined each science: theology defends but does not deliver certainty; philosophy excels in mathematics and stumbles in metaphysics; only the Sufi path delivered what it promised.
representative_cases_zh: 《迷途指津》的四路体检直接决定了安萨里后半生的学术版图：保留教义学教材写作（域内有效）、系统吸收哲学逻辑（跨域移植）、拒绝伊斯玛仪派（机制失效）、皈依并改造苏菲（唯一达标）——一份 11 世纪的'选型决策记录'，每项结论都附失效条款。
跨域移植的示范：他把哲学逻辑从'形而上体系'中剥离，单独移植进教义学与法理学课程——分域体检的价值正在于能识别'体系中哪部分在哪个域内仍然有效'，避免连车带库一起抛弃。
对伊斯玛仪派的机制诊断：他不与其具体教义缠斗，而直指其认识机制（'从权威接受真理而不经论证'）——机制层失败者，无论内容多丰富都不可用；这是'审查交付机制而非审查结论'的经典示范。
反例警示：体检结论随目标改变而失效——他的分域结论以'确信'为目标尺；若目标是数学研究，哲学的评级将完全不同。不注明目标尺的分域结论会被误用为普适排名。
representative_cases_en: The four-way audit of al-Munqidh fixed al-Ghazali's later career: keep writing theology textbooks (valid in-domain), absorb philosophical logic systematically (cross-domain transplant), reject Isma'ilism (mechanism fails), embrace and reform Sufism (the only route that delivered)—an eleventh-century selection-decision record with failure clauses attached to every verdict.

A demonstration of cross-domain transplant: he stripped philosophical logic from its 'metaphysical system' and grafted it alone into theology and jurisprudence curricula—the value of domain triage is precisely identifying which parts of a system remain valid in which domain, avoiding scrapping the whole vehicle with its library.

The mechanism diagnosis of Isma'ilism: he refuses to wrestle with its specific doctrines and strikes at its epistemic mechanism ('receiving truth from authority without argument')—a mechanism-level failure is unusable however rich its content; the classic demonstration of auditing delivery mechanisms rather than conclusions.

Counter-case: triage verdicts expire when the goal changes—his demarcations are scaled to 'certainty' as the goal; had the goal been mathematical research, philosophy's rating would differ entirely. Domain verdicts that omit their goal-yardstick get misused as universal rankings.
modern_applications_zh: 技术选型/方法论选型：用统一体检框架评估候选方案并划定适用域
个人学习投资组合：对'读博/培训/自学/实践'各路径做交付-失效点审计
AI 模型评估：按任务域分别体检，拒绝'一个模型全域能干'的笼统判断
组织能力盘点：对内部各职能做'宣称-交付-失效点'三问，定编制与外包边界
modern_applications_en: Tech and methodology selection: run the uniform audit battery on candidates and demarcate validity domains
Personal learning portfolio: audit degree / bootcamp / self-study / practice paths by delivery and failure points
AI model evaluation: assess per task domain; reject blanket 'one model does all' claims
Organizational capability review: put each function through promise-delivery-failure triage to set hiring and outsourcing boundaries

modes.definition_zh: 行为与作品的价值不由其外在质量单独决定，而由其动机结构决定：同一篇讲道，为真理而讲与为名声而讲，在'价值层'上是完全不同的两个行为；被虚荣污染的学术可以在外部指标上全优而内在归零甚至为负。因此需要对自身动机做制度化'审计'：我此刻行为的真实回报期望是什么——真理、影响，还是掌声？要害有三：其一，动机（niyya）是行为价值的决定变量，外部产出只是必要非充分证据；其二，污染是渐进与自我遮蔽的——'最能欺骗自己的莫过于自己的心'，虚荣入于学问如毒入于饮食，色味俱佳而饮者立仆，故审计不能依赖临场自觉；其三，审计必须制度化——定时（周期性）、对照（无曝光测试：若此行为永不为人所知，我还会做吗？）、外部镜子（诤友/导师的旁观诊断），必要时暂停净化（离开污染环境）。方法论签名：外部指标满分而动机污染的行为，内在价值为零——先审'为什么做'，再评估'做得怎样'。
modes.definition_en: The worth of an act is set by its motivational structure, not by its external quality alone: the same sermon delivered for truth and for fame are two different acts at the value-layer; learning tainted by vanity can score perfectly on external metrics while voiding itself within—even going negative. Motives therefore need an institutionalized audit: what is this act's real expected return—truth, impact, or applause? Three essentials: intention (niyya) is the decisive variable of an act's value; external output is necessary but insufficient evidence; contamination is gradual and self-masking—'nothing deceives you like your own heart'; vanity entering learning is poison entering food, fine in color and taste, deadly in effect—so the audit cannot rely on in-the-moment self-awareness; and the audit must be institutionalized—scheduled (periodic), comparative (the invisibility test: if this act would never be known, would I still do it, and at what quality?), and externally mirrored (a truth-telling friend's or mentor's outside diagnosis), with pauses and purification—leaving the contaminated environment—when needed. Signature: an act with perfect external metrics but contaminated motive has zero inner value—audit 'why it is done' before appraising 'how well it is done.'
modes.source_chapter: 《圣学复苏》卷四'自毁之德'（Muḥlikāt）论虚荣与自炫章、《致孩子的书》
process_zh: 为高价值行为（作品、决策、承诺）建立'动机登记'：写下真实的回报期望
对照检验（无曝光测试）：若此行为永不为人所知，我还会做吗？以何种质量做？
识别污染信号：投入向'可见部分'倾斜、回避批评、热衷署名与传播
制度化纠偏：定时审计、引入外部镜子（诤友/导师）、必要时暂停净化或离开污染环境
process_en: Register motives for high-value acts (works, decisions, commitments): write down the real expected return
Run the comparison test (invisibility test): if the act would never be known, would I still do it—and at what quality?
Detect contamination signals: effort tilting toward the 'visible part,' dodging criticism, craving credit and amplification
Institutionalize correction: scheduled audits, an external mirror (truth-teller/mentor), and pause-purify or leave the contaminated environment when needed
modes.key_quote_zh: 最善于欺骗你的，莫过于你自己的心——虚荣入于学问，如毒入于饮食：色味俱佳，饮者立仆。
modes.key_quote_en: Nothing deceives you like your own heart: vanity entering learning is poison entering food—fine in color and taste, deadly in effect.
representative_cases_zh: 1095年危机的被低估维度：安萨里在《迷途指津》中自陈，危机前他已察觉自己'追求名望的动机潜入教学'——帝国首席教授的地位恰是虚荣最丰沃的培养皿。他辞去的不仅是教职，更是一个被污染的动机环境；十年归乡后以'为真理而非为宫廷'的重建动机写作《圣学复苏》。'动机审计→环境脱敏→重建'的三段处理，与认识论怀疑线并行构成其危机回应的完整双线。
《圣学复苏》'自毁之德'卷的系统编目：他把毁坏虔诚的动机逐条编目——虚荣（riya'，为人而做）、自炫（sum'a，让人知道）、傲慢（kibr，轻视他人）——每一种都给出识别信号与解毒剂，把动机污染从'道德告诫'升级为'可操作的排查清单'。
对学者的专门警告：'学者的虚荣比常人的更隐蔽也更致命，因为学者能用学问为虚荣辩护'——对知识工作者动机污染的机制性洞察：专业能力越强，自我欺骗的修辞资源越丰富。
反例警示：动机审计若变成自我折磨的强迫症即告失效——安萨里同时强调'真主不责成能力之外的事'，审计的目的是校正方向而非瘫痪行动；无休止的自查会变成另一种自我关注（以'我的动机纯不纯'为中心的变相虚荣）。
representative_cases_en: The underrated dimension of the 1095 crisis: in al-Munqidh al-Ghazali confesses that before the crisis he had noticed 'the pursuit of fame creeping into his teaching'—the imperial chair was a hothouse of vanity. He resigned not just a post but a contaminated motivational environment; a decade later he wrote the Revival from a rebuilt intention 'for truth, not for courts.' Motive-audit, environmental detox, rebuild—the twin line running alongside his epistemic doubt.

The systematic catalog in the Revival's 'Book of Destructive Matters': vices that destroy devotion itemized—vanity (riya', doing for others to see), self-display (sum'a', letting it be known), arrogance (kibr, despising others)—each with detection signals and antidotes, upgrading motive contamination from moral exhortation to an operational screening checklist.

A special warning for scholars: 'the scholar's vanity is subtler and deadlier than the common man's, for the scholar can use his learning to defend his vanity'—a structural insight into knowledge workers' motive pollution: the stronger the expertise, the richer the rhetorical resources for self-deception.

Counter-case: motive auditing fails when it hardens into self-tormenting compulsion—al-Ghazali equally stresses 'God charges no soul beyond its capacity'; the audit's aim is course correction, not paralysis of action; endless self-scrutiny becomes another form of self-absorption (inverted vanity centered on 'how pure are my motives').
modern_applications_zh: 研究者/创作者的定期动机审计：区分'为问题'与'为指标'的投入占比
组织激励设计：识别 KPI 对内在动机的污染（挤出效应），设置不可见工作保护区
领导力治理：把'无曝光测试'作为重大公共承诺的前置自检
学术诚信制度：署名规则、利益冲突申报作为'动机结构'的外部化审计
modern_applications_en: Scheduled motive audits for researchers and creators: separate problem-driven vs metric-driven effort shares
Incentive design: detect KPI contamination of intrinsic motives (crowding-out); protect zones of invisible work
Leadership governance: run the invisibility test before major public commitments
Research-integrity systems: authorship rules and conflict-of-interest disclosure as externalized audits of motivational structure

modes.definition_zh: 知识有两类：'刀剑之知'（概念、定义、论证的累积）与'闪电之知'（体验、能力、确信的达成）；前者的累积本身不产生后者的任何一寸——关于健康的百科全书不能治病，关于醉酒的论文不能醉人。当学习量持续增长而行为与状态毫无改变时，说明已发生'知行断裂'——知识停止转化为实践，转而在内部自循环（为讲而学、为写而学、为再学而学）。要害有三：其一，以行为改变为知识的验收标准——任何学习投资都必须回答'它将改变我的哪个具体行为'，否则按无效投资处理；其二，识别自循环病症——学习产出仍是学习（笔记、文章、课程）而非行动，是断裂的确诊信号；其三，重组知识体系按疗效而非按对象——《圣学复苏》全书把教义学内容重排为'行为学（外部实践）—自毁学（需戒除的）—自救学（需建立的）'的实践序列，宣告按'知识对象'划分学科的传统无效。方法论签名：验收知识不看库存量，看行为改变量——知道旅行的全部知识而不启程者，永远到不了麦加。
modes.definition_en: Knowledge is of two kinds: 'knowledge of the sword' (accumulated concepts, definitions, arguments) and 'knowledge of the flash' (attained experience, capacity, conviction); accumulating the former yields not an inch of the latter—an encyclopedia of health cures no one, a treatise on drunkenness intoxicates no one. When learning keeps growing while behavior and state stand still, a knowledge-action rift has opened: knowledge has stopped converting into practice and now self-circulates (learning to lecture, to write, to learn again). Three essentials: behavioral change as knowledge's acceptance criterion—every learning investment must answer 'which specific behavior of mine will it change?', else it books as invalid; detect the self-circulation pathology—learning whose output is still learning (notes, articles, courses) rather than action is the confirmed symptom of the rift; and reorganize knowledge by therapeutic yield, not by object—the Revival re-arranges theology into the practical sequence of acts (outer practice), destructive matters (to be removed), and saving matters (to be built), declaring the traditional division of disciplines by 'object of knowledge' void. Signature: accept knowledge not by inventory size but by behavior changed—the man who knows all about travel yet never sets out never reaches Mecca.
modes.source_chapter: 《圣学复苏》卷一'知识之益在于行动'章、《致孩子的书》
key_concepts: 刀剑之知 vs 闪电之知
process_zh: 对当前知识存量做疗效审计：哪些已转化为行为，哪些只是库存？
为新学习设立行为验收条款：预登记'此项知识将改变的具体行为'
识别自循环信号：学习产出仍是学习（笔记、文章、课程）而非行动
重构学习流程：每单位知识输入强制绑定一个实践输出与复盘，按疗效重组知识体系
process_en: Audit current knowledge stock for therapeutic yield: what has converted into behavior, what is mere inventory?
Set behavioral acceptance clauses for new learning: pre-register the specific behavior this knowledge will change
Detect self-circulation signals: learning whose output is still learning (notes, articles, courses), not action
Rebuild the learning pipeline: bind every unit of input to one practice output plus retrospective; re-organize knowledge by therapeutic yield
modes.key_quote_zh: 凡是不由知识进入行动的，其知识终将连同行动一起消失；'知道旅行的全部知识而不启程者，永远到不了麦加'。
modes.key_quote_en: Knowledge that never enters action perishes along with it: the man who knows all about travel but never sets out never reaches Mecca.
representative_cases_zh: 《圣学复苏》的结构本身即此模式的示范：全书四卷把教义学内容重排为'行为学（外部实践，如礼拜、日常伦理）—自毁学（需戒除的：虚荣、怒、嫉妒）—自救学（需建立的：悔悟、坚忍、托靠）'的实践序列——宣告传统学科分类按'知识对象'划分无效，必须按'对灵魂的疗效'重新划分。这是11世纪版本的'课程体系以学习成果而非学科传统重组'。
'知识之益在于行动'章的判例：他引述'知道旅行的全部知识而不启程者，到不了麦加'并推到极致——'不因知识而行动的知识，终将连同行动的可能性一起消失'：库存知识有半衰期，越囤积越惰化。
对教义学家的诊断：他批评同时代教义学家'能精确定义健康而不能健康'——高概念产出、零行为转化，正是知行断裂在学术职业中的形态；这也是他辞教之后'先修后写'《圣学复苏》的理由：书的结构必须服从疗效序列而非学科序列。
反例警示：行动主义同样可以是断裂——'只行不学'的实践缺乏刀剑之知的导航，会陷入盲目重复；安萨里的阶梯（M-GHZ-010）要求知与行交替上升，单极的'学习囤积'与单极的'蛮干'都是断裂。
representative_cases_en: The Revival's own structure demonstrates the method: four books re-arrange theology into the practical sequence of Acts (outer practice—worship, daily ethics), Destructive Matters (to be removed—vanity, anger, envy), and Saving Matters (to be built—repentance, endurance, trust)—declaring the traditional division of disciplines by object void: knowledge must be re-divided by therapeutic yield for the soul. An eleventh-century version of re-designing curricula around learning outcomes rather than disciplinary tradition.

The standing verdict of 'the benefit of knowledge lies in action': he cites 'the man who knows all about travel but never sets out never reaches Mecca' and pushes it further—'knowledge that does not issue in action will perish together with the possibility of action': stockpiled knowledge has a half-life; the more hoarded, the more inert.

The diagnosis of the theologians: he faults his contemporaries who 'can define health precisely yet are not healthy'—high conceptual output, zero behavioral conversion, the rift's professional form in academia; hence after resigning he wrote the Revival 'practicing first, writing after': the book's structure must obey the therapeutic sequence, not the disciplinary one.

Counter-case: activism can be the same rift in reverse—'acting without learning' lacks the sword-knowledge's navigation and falls into blind repetition; al-Ghazali's ladder (M-GHZ-010) requires knowledge and action to alternate upward—unilateral 'learning hoarding' and unilateral 'grinding' are both rifts.
modern_applications_zh: 企业培训效果评估：以行为改变率替代课时与考试通过率
个人阅读/课程体系：预登记行为验收条款，砍掉纯库存型学习
组织变革管理：诊断'全员知道但无人改变'的知行断裂点
知识管理工具设计：笔记系统加入'行为转化'字段，把收藏夹变成行动队列
modern_applications_en: Corporate training evaluation: measure behavior-change rate, not seat hours and exam pass rates
Personal reading and course systems: pre-register behavioral acceptance clauses; cut pure inventory learning
Change management: diagnose the rift where 'everyone knows yet nothing changes'
Knowledge-tool design: add a behavior-conversion field to note systems; turn read-later queues into action queues

modes.definition_zh: 规范的效力根源于其目的：沙里亚的全部规定指向五个被保护的根本宗旨（maqasid）——护教、护命、护智、护裔、护产。因此对任何具体规则的理解、适用与质疑，都应回到'它保护哪一宗旨、保护效果如何'的层面检验：字面遵从而宗旨落空的规则是空壳；宗旨可达而手段更佳时应择优。要害有三：其一，目的论解释优先——规则是宗旨的实现工具而非自足圣物，解释冲突时宗旨压倒字面；其二，无明文也可生义务——安萨里在《法理学精要》中以'防止火灾'从护命宗旨推导出经文中并无明文的义务，确立'宗旨可独立于明文产生规范力'的原理；其三，规则演化的'宗旨不变式'——随情境变化选择更能实现宗旨的手段不等于背叛规范，恰是忠于规范的本质；允许手段更新，禁止宗旨漂移。方法论签名：律法的字句是舟，宗旨是岸——舟离了岸，纵然雕饰得再美，也载不动任何人。
modes.definition_en: The validity of norms is rooted in their purpose: revelation's provisions all aim at five protected essentials (maqasid)—religion, life, intellect, lineage, property. Any concrete rule must therefore be understood, applied, and challenged at the level of 'which essential does it protect, and how well?' A rule obeyed to the letter while its purpose is voided is an empty shell; where the purpose is attainable by better means, the better means deserves preference. Three essentials: teleological interpretation has priority—rules are instruments for realizing purposes, not self-sufficient sacred objects; when interpretation conflicts, purpose outweighs the letter; obligations can arise without explicit text—in the Mustasfa al-Ghazali derives from the purpose of protecting life an obligation (fire precautions) absent from any explicit text, establishing that purposes can generate normative force independently of wording; and a 'purpose invariant' for rule evolution—choosing, as circumstances change, the means that better realizes the purpose is not betrayal of the norm but its very essence: means may update, purpose must not drift. Signature: the letter of the law is the boat, its purposes the shore—however ornate, a boat off the shore carries no one.
modes.source_chapter: 《法理学精要》（al-Mustaṣfā）论 maqāṣid 章、《圣学复苏》论法之宗旨
key_concepts: 字面遵从 vs 宗旨达成
process_zh: 对任一规则追问：它保护哪一根本宗旨？保护机制是什么？
评估字面遵从与宗旨达成之间的偏差：规则是否已空壳化？
在宗旨不变的前提下搜索更优手段，并论证其不损害其他宗旨
为规则演化建立'宗旨不变式'：允许手段更新，禁止宗旨漂移，定期做空壳化复查
process_en: Ask of any rule: which essential does it protect, and by what mechanism?
Assess the gap between literal compliance and purpose achievement: has the rule shell-ified?
Search for better means under an unchanged purpose, arguing they damage no other essential
Institute a 'purpose invariant' for rule evolution: means may update, purpose must not drift; audit for shell-ification on a schedule
modes.key_quote_zh: 律法的字句是舟，宗旨是岸——舟离了岸，纵然雕饰得再美，也载不动任何人。
modes.key_quote_en: The letter of the law is the boat, its purposes the shore: however ornate, a boat off the shore carries no one.
representative_cases_zh: 《法理学精要》的防火判例：安萨里以'护命'宗旨推导出'必须配备防火设备'这类经文与圣训均无明文的义务，并确立'宗旨可独立于明文产生规范力'的原理——这一步使伊斯兰法理学从字面注释学转向目的论法学，经其后继者（沙提比、伊本·阿舒尔）发展为现代 maqasid 法理学，成为当代伊斯兰法改革（金融创新、医疗伦理）的核心方法论。
五宗旨作为利益清单的枚举力：护教、护命、护智、护裔、护产——一份11世纪的'不可让渡根本利益清单'，任何新规则、新技术、新政策都可对照它做影响评估；当代 maqasid 学者用它评估生物技术、金融工程与人工智能。
手段与宗旨的分离判例：他允许在宗旨不变时更换手段（如以类比与公益 istihsan 补充明文），同时严惩'以变通之名漂移宗旨'——为规则系统的演化划出了可动与不可动的边界。
反例警示：无宗旨约束的字面主义导致空壳规则（为守斋而危害生命即为其例，他明确以护命宗旨中止），而无所不变式的'目的论'则沦为'目的为任何结论背书'的空转——宗旨不变式是目的论方法的防身衣。
representative_cases_en: The fire-precaution precedent in the Mustasfa: from the purpose of protecting life al-Ghazali derives the obligation to keep fire-fighting equipment, absent from any explicit text or tradition, establishing that purposes can generate normative force independently of wording—one step that turned Islamic jurisprudence from literal commentary into teleological law, maturing through al-Shatibi and Ibn Ashur into modern maqasid theory, the core methodology of contemporary Islamic law reform (financial innovation, medical ethics).

The enumerative power of five essentials as an interest list: religion, life, intellect, lineage, property—an eleventh-century 'list of inalienable fundamental interests' against which any new rule, technology, or policy can be impact-assessed; modern maqasid scholars apply it to biotechnology, financial engineering, and AI.

A precedent for separating means from ends: he permits changing means while the purpose stands (analogy and public-interest istihsan supplementing explicit texts) while severely punishing 'drifting the purpose under the name of accommodation'—delineating the movable from the immovable in a rule system's evolution.

Counter-case: literalism without purpose yields shell rules (fasting that endangers life is expressly suspended by the purpose of protecting life), while 'teleology' without a purpose invariant degenerates into a rubber stamp endorsing any conclusion—the purpose invariant is teleology's protective garment.
modern_applications_zh: 合规与政策设计：为每条规则登记'保护宗旨'，定期做空壳化检查
组织制度演化：以'宗旨不变式'管理规则更新，防止教条僵化与原则漂移两败
产品伦理治理：以根本利益清单（隐私、安全、公平）作为功能取舍的最终裁判
宪法与监管解释：目的主义解释与'监管宗旨不变式'（regulatory purpose invariance）
modern_applications_en: Compliance and policy design: register each rule's protected purpose; audit for shell-ification on a schedule
Institutional evolution: manage rule updates under a purpose invariant—avoiding both dogmatic rigidity and principle drift
Product ethics governance: an essential-interests list (privacy, safety, fairness) as the final adjudicator of feature trade-offs
Constitutional and regulatory interpretation: purposivism and the regulatory purpose invariant

modes.definition_zh: 深度转化不是顿悟事件，而是可工程化的阶梯过程：知识（知其病与其药）→行动（服药）→净化（排除障碍）→阶位（maqamat：悔悟、警醒、托靠、满足……）→确信（心之光降临）。每一阶有其明确的进入条件、典型障碍与检验标志；不可跳阶（无净化之行的知识'终将消失'），也不可滞阶（以修行为名逃避职责）。要害有三：其一，序列不可乱——'心之病如身之病：药有其性，病有其序，乱序服药不惟无益反增其疾'，转化有内在次序，快进即失败；其二，每阶可检验——为每阶定义'可观察的行为/状态标志'作为通过判据，使精神进步从神秘恩宠变成可复盘的进程；其三，工程化而非事件化——把'人格改变'重新定义为可规划、可检验、可复利的长期项目，配有最小可行路线图（《致孩子的书》：砍掉'为辩而学的学科'，只保留'直达目标的实践阶梯'）。方法论签名：阶位不可跳，恩光不可求——转化是工程，不是彩票。
modes.definition_en: Deep transformation is not a lightning event but an engineerable ladder: knowledge (knowing the disease and its remedy) → action (taking the remedy) → purification (clearing obstacles) → stations (maqamat: repentance, vigilance, trust, contentment...) → certainty (the descent of the heart's light). Each rung has explicit entry conditions, typical obstacles, and test marks; no skipping (knowledge without the journey of purification 'will perish'), no stalling (retreat disguised as piety evading one's duties). Three essentials: the sequence admits no disorder—'diseases of the heart are like diseases of the body: remedies have their nature, illnesses their order; remedies taken out of order not only fail but worsen the sickness'—transformation has an intrinsic order and fast-forwarding is failure; each rung is testable—define observable behavioral or state marks as pass criteria, turning spiritual progress from mysterious grace into a reviewable process; and engineered, not eventful—re-define personal change as a plannable, verifiable, compounding long-term project, complete with a minimal viable roadmap (the Letter to a Disciple: cut the 'sciences studied for disputation,' keep only the practice ladder aimed straight at the goal). Signature: rungs may not be skipped, grace cannot be demanded—transformation is engineering, not a lottery.
modes.source_chapter: 《圣学复苏》卷三-卷四（救赎学/救赎之障碍）、《致孩子的书》
process_zh: 诊断当前位置：诚实地确定自己所在的阶及其典型障碍
满足进入条件：下一阶所需的知识与前提实践是否齐备？缺则先补
设定检验标志：为每阶定义'可观察的行为/状态标志'作为通过判据
循环推进：以'知-行-净'小循环逐阶上行，定期复盘防止滞阶或跳阶
process_en: Diagnose your current rung: honestly locate your station and its typical obstacles
Meet entry conditions: are the knowledge and prerequisite practices for the next rung in place? If not, supply them first
Set test marks: define observable behavioral/state signs as pass criteria for each rung
Advance in loops: climb rung by rung via small know-act-purify cycles; retrospective on schedule to prevent stalling or skipping
modes.key_quote_zh: 心之病如身之病：药有其性，病有其序——乱序服药，不惟无益，反增其疾；阶位不可跳，恩光不可求。
modes.key_quote_en: Diseases of the heart are like diseases of the body: remedies have their order—to take them out of order worsens the illness; stations cannot be skipped.
representative_cases_zh: 安萨里本人的十年（1095-1105）就是阶梯的实修记录：辞官（脱障）→大马士革苦修（行动）→耶路撒冷圣殿闭关（净化）→麦加麦地那环游（阶位上行）→'确信之光'降临（目的地）——每一阶段有明确的地点、时长与对应阶位，是一份可复核的个人转化工程日志。
《致孩子的书》的最小可行方案：他把十年经验压缩为给弟子的最小路线图——砍掉'为辩而学的学科'（教义学辩论术），只保留'直达目标的实践阶梯'（清净、斋戒、诵念、独处），并给出每项的频次与禁忌——一份11世纪的个人转化工程 MVP 文档。
阶位理论的制度化影响：maqamat（阶位）与 ahwal（状态）的区分被苏菲传统系统化——'阶位'是修行者通过努力获得并保持的稳定位阶，'状态'是真主临时赐予不可强求——这一区分把'可努力的'与'不可强求的'分入两个管理域，是转化工程学的核心概念切分。
反例警示：跳阶失败与滞阶失败各有形态——跳阶者以'顿悟'叙事跳过净化，崩塌于第一次诱惑（'无净化之行的知识终将消失'）；滞阶者以'修行'为名逃避社会职责，安萨里明确要求修行者回归职业与家庭——阶梯的两端都有悬崖。
representative_cases_en: Al-Ghazali's own decade (1095-1105) is the ladder in practice: resignation (detachment) → Damascus austerities (action) → Jerusalem seclusion in the Temple area (purification) → circumambulation of Mecca and Medina (stations ascending) → the descent of 'the light of certainty' (arrival)—each stage with explicit place, duration, and corresponding rung: a reviewable logbook of personal transformation engineering.

The minimal viable plan in the Letter to a Disciple: he compresses the decade into a minimal roadmap for his disciple—cut the 'sciences studied for disputation' (kalam polemics), keep only the practice ladder aimed straight at the goal (purity, fasting, litany, seclusion), with frequency and prohibitions for each—an eleventh-century MVP document of personal transformation engineering.

The institutional legacy of station theory: the distinction between maqamat (stations) and ahwal (states) was systematized in the Sufi tradition—'stations' are stable ranks earned and kept by effort; 'states' are transient gifts of God that cannot be demanded—partitioning 'what can be worked for' from 'what cannot be forced' into two management domains, a core conceptual cut of transformation engineering.

Counter-case: skipped-rung and stalled-rung failures each take a shape—the skipper leaps purification via 'sudden awakening' narratives and collapses at the first temptation ('knowledge without the journey will perish'); the staller evades social duty in the name of 'practice,' and al-Ghazali expressly requires the practitioner to return to profession and family—the ladder has cliffs at both ends.
modern_applications_zh: 长期自我提升（戒断、技能、领导力）：以阶位模型替代'新年决心'式跃进
组织文化转型：识别'跳阶失败'（未脱障先立新制）并按阶推进
康复与成瘾治疗：阶段性行为改变模型（跨理论模型 TTM）与之一脉相承
个人知识管理：把成长目标拆为带检验标志的阶位序列，定期复盘防滞阶
modern_applications_en: Long-term self-change (habit breaking, skills, leadership): a station model instead of resolution-style leaps
Culture transformation: detect 'skipped-rung' failures (new systems imposed before obstacles cleared); advance stage by stage
Recovery and addiction treatment: the transtheoretical model (TTM) of staged behavior change is the same lineage
Personal knowledge management: decompose growth goals into station sequences with test marks; retrospective on schedule against stalling
